scope: Completion of all 22 formerly deferred scenarios plus direct registration/resume/attachment and settings layout boundaries.

reviews.conclusion: No project-owned test was found that drives the complete terminal journey against an installed Codex/Claude CLI.
reviews.limit: Searched all Go test/support files, build tags, mcp-cli/native-resume fixtures, attachment code and repository test tooling. Related evidence uses shell/cat processes, captured drivers or manager attachment handles. No complete installed-agent journey, raw Ctrl+K restoration assertion or UI capture/baseline was found.
reviews.suggestion: Add an explicit project-owned terminal E2E test using isolated HOME/config/workspaces and an installed agent; assert launch, registration, attach/detach restoration and selected native resume.
reviews.reason: External CLI behavior and terminal mode restoration cannot be established by fake Spawn or manager-handle tests.

reviews.conclusion: The shell-agent interoperability test exercises the deployed endpoint/credential and report persistence/retry through an installed mcp-cli.
reviews.limit: Shell/cat agent rather than Codex/Claude; does not establish native agent task execution.

reviews.conclusion: Capture-driver assertions cover explicit saved/new choices and per-card IDs while retaining the original workspace.
reviews.limit: Spawn is overridden; these are actual manager lifecycle and argument assertions, not a native CLI run.

reviews.conclusion: Real cat attachment replays the exact input bytes after closing and reopening the handle.
reviews.limit: Does not exercise attachExec terminal mode, Ctrl+K or SIGWINCH.

reviews.conclusion: The o key targets the selected session; shared command execution validates cwd and argument substitution.
reviews.limit: No retained test drives a successful o command through the coordinator and asserts the actual IDE child cwd/argv. The real child test covers the common launcher, and the IDE callback is directly tested for missing configuration.
reviews.suggestion: Drive o with an isolated helper executable configured as IDECommand and assert the child cwd/argv and scoped completion.
reviews.reason: Terminal and IDE settings are independent; shared-launcher coverage does not prove successful IDE wiring.

reviews.conclusion: Retained tests establish edited callback payloads and exact repository round trips; successful SettingsSavedMsg application is exercised by terminal launch tests.
reviews.limit: No direct retained assertion links a save key through the real settings callback, durable YAML, refreshed editor visibility and return navigation as one journey; no genuine failed settings save is asserted.
reviews.suggestion: Exercise the settings callback through save completion, assert persisted values/editor visibility/navigation, then inject a real save failure and assert the error path.
reviews.reason: The reported error test never executes its error command; failed persistence must not look like a successful save.

reviews.conclusion: Repository callbacks preserve workspace-source identity and reject malformed registry mutations. Search reviewed: internal/ui/views/{card_editor*,workspace_picker*,source_manager*}_test.go and internal/app/{navigation,integration,source_save,source_sync_warning}_test.go; Ctrl+E/OnOpenWorkspaces call sites.
reviews.limit: Searched editor/navigation/source tests: no direct assertion of Ctrl+E from both Workspace/Sub Workspaces, source edit, Esc return and preservation of the unsaved card was found.
reviews.suggestion: Drive Ctrl+E from each workspace field, save a source, return with Esc and compare the unsaved card/focus.
reviews.reason: Cross-view refresh can overwrite unsaved editor state even when repository callbacks work.

reviews.conclusion: The retained regression verifies selected-only filtering/cursor behavior across a registry refresh and toggles the visible selection.
reviews.limit: No direct Ctrl+S assertion, selected-only header assertion or selected-only/search/save round trip was found in editor and capability-list tests.
reviews.suggestion: Send Ctrl+S on Skills and outside Skills; check header, search subset, saved selections and second-toggle restoration.
reviews.reason: SetSelectedOnly coverage alone cannot detect a broken keyboard binding.

reviews.conclusion: No direct test was found that focuses Use Tmp Workspace, sends Space and asserts false→true→false plus the saved value. Search reviewed: all 134 Go test/support files, especially card_editor_test.go/layout/setsize, capability-list tests and temporary-workspace lifecycle fixtures; CardEditor.handleKey/handleSpace/Card traced.
reviews.limit: Repository-wide Test/fixture search reviewed FocusUseTmp, useTmpWorkspace, UseTmpWorkspace and key handling. Existing round-trip/lifecycle tests seed this boolean directly; they establish preservation or workspace behavior, not this input action.
reviews.suggestion: Add a model-level key test that focuses Use Tmp Workspace, checks both Space transitions and submits the expected card flag.
reviews.reason: A broken toggle can launch into an original workspace when the user intended an isolated copy.

reviews.conclusion: The keyboard-level view test covers multiple checks across searches, unresolved entries, cancel/confirm and returning to single-selection main mode.
reviews.limit: Form callback payload and view text only; source copying is a separate runtime flow.

reviews.conclusion: The editor/picker regression directly checks missing rows, cancellation, explicit deselection and retaining a checked ID absent at confirmation.
reviews.limit: Controlled DataLoadedMsg refreshes in the model; no screenshot or source-registry race claim.

reviews.conclusion: A coordinator key journey launches a real helper child in the temporary session workspace and checks its arguments and successful scoped completion.
reviews.limit: The child is a test executable, not a graphical terminal emulator; only one configured command template is exercised here.

reviews.conclusion: Tests check command/path failures and delivery of a spawn failure to the coordinator error banner.
reviews.limit: Checks the listed API/callback cases and banner presence; not exact error copy or external app startup errors after exec succeeds.

reviews.conclusion: View-level assertions cover field focus, independent text, trimming on save and restoration on cancel.
reviews.limit: Tests use in-memory callbacks; durable saving is assessed separately.

reviews.conclusion: Manager tests separately assert immediate attachment, delayed delivery, registration independence and inspection snapshot preservation.
reviews.limit: Controlled startup timers and local processes; delivery eligibility still does not prove an AI agent can process a task.

reviews.conclusion: Retained service and real-HTTP tests assert controller authority, registration-only denial, scoped listings and idempotent scoped creation.
reviews.limit: HTTP test directly covers list_sessions; the broader lifecycle authorization checks use the shared service. No arbitrary credential fuzzing.

reviews.conclusion: Assertions cover concurrent duplicate requests, conflicting fingerprints, bounded queues, disconnected waits, late cancellation, post-effect journal warnings and interrupted/corrupt recovery.
reviews.limit: Controlled local runner/real cat fixtures and constructed durable records; no OS crash or exhaustive scheduling proof.

reviews.conclusion: Retained tests assert activation-pinned submission, replay conflict behavior, journal rollback and capacity recovery without leaked admission.
reviews.limit: Submission/history invariants under local fixtures; no AI-agent task-processing or external client UX claim.

reviews.conclusion: The service lifecycle test asserts stop/switch/relaunch/delete and stable replay; removal tests check running guards/temp cleanup and messaging tests check recipient history deletion.
reviews.limit: Local cat processes; no proof every descendant process group is killed. UI confirmations are a separate interaction boundary.

reviews.conclusion: Capability assertions cover conditional/deduplicated access+puppet selection; root tests compare actual deployed bytes with the embedded content.
reviews.limit: Embedded file/selection contract only. No end-to-end assertion that an AI agent follows registration/report instructions.

reviews.conclusion: The create form validates name and callback payload; the service test checks create/update inventory equality and immutable identity.
reviews.limit: No direct retained assertion was found for e-driven edit form, selection preservation across SetDashboards reorder, or the whole callback/generation/save-refresh journey.
reviews.suggestion: Select a dashboard, edit with e, save and reorder/refresh inventory; assert name/description, immutable selected ID and scoped completion.
reviews.reason: Name sorting changes can move the cursor to a different dashboard even when saved IDs remain valid.

reviews.conclusion: Manager/service tests assert attachment replay, remove guards/cleanup and naming failure; the launcher checks pending/retry behavior and the command harness drives captured actions.
reviews.limit: No retained test establishes a complete dashboard-key→scoped-service→persisted rename/stop/remove journey or raw attachExec detach/terminal restoration. Tests of the individual layers do not establish their full composition.
reviews.suggestion: Drive owned/foreign session actions through coordinator commands, assert persisted name and removal effects, and add a project-owned terminal detach/restoration journey.
reviews.reason: Scoped asynchronous actions and raw attachment cross ownership and terminal-state boundaries.

reviews.conclusion: The recovery regression asserts durable failed-cleanup identity survives card edits and restart, then removes only the captured temporary root and clears its error.
reviews.limit: Controlled copier and permissions; no general filesystem failure or power-loss claim.

reviews.conclusion: Direct view assertions cover sanitized bounded preflight/status errors, cancellation/success clearing and long errors when no dashboards remain.
reviews.limit: Layout and injected message interaction only; deletion effects are assessed separately.

reviews.conclusion: Queued notification cancellation asserts no terminal submission and released lifecycle reservation; deletion revokes saved authority and ordinary delivery shutdown is deadline-checked.
reviews.limit: The notification case cancels captured authority directly. No dedicated retained assertion was found that runner.Shutdown itself cancels a notification queued or blocked at the PTY boundary and joins its dispatcher.
reviews.suggestion: Queue a real notification, call runner.Shutdown while it is gated, then assert dispatcher/workers finish, no bytes are written and the destination reservation is released.
reviews.reason: Shutdown must not leave queued notification work or block application exit.

reviews.conclusion: Direct layout assertions cover display/edit modes, sanitized text, visible controls/help and width/height limits.
reviews.limit: Two tested view sizes; no screenshot comparison or native terminal font guarantee.
